  changed its footer wording, detection fails silently and
  normalizeDiscoveredSessions then drops the question and resets the state
  to idle — which is exactly what you saw.

The Android AAB is building. Once it finishes, what should happen with it?

❯ 1. Hold it — just give me the artifact
     Leave the .aab on Expo's servers. Nothing goes to Google. Sensible if
     you don't have a Play Console account yet, since submission needs one
     ($25 one-off) and there's no rush.
  2. Submit to Play internal testing
     Upload it to Google Play's internal testing track, the Android
     equivalent of TestFlight. Requires a Play Console account and an app
     listing already created there.
  3. Also build an installable APK
     Kick off a second build from the preview profile producing an APK you
     can sideload onto a device today, alongside the AAB waiting for Play.
  4. Type something.
